senses.gloss:
[दुल्-घञ्] 
__1 Swinging, rocking, oscillating; वेलादोलानिलचलम् [[Mb. 1. 21. 10.]] 
__2 A swing, litter. 
__3 A festival held on the fourteenth or full-moon day of the month of Phālguna when figures of ‘young Kṛṣṇa’ (बालकृष्ण) are swung in a swing. 
-Comp. 
-मण्डपः, -पम्, यानम् a swing.

दोला,
दोलिका 
__1 A litter, palanquin. 
__2 A swing, hammock (fig. also); आसीत् स दोलाचलचित्तवृत्तिः [[R. 14. 34]]; 9. 46; 19. 44; संदेहदोलामारोप्यते [[K. 207.]] 
__3 Swinging, fluctuation. 
__4 Doubt, uncertainty. 
__5 The Indigo plant. 
-Comp. 
-अधिरूढ, -आरूढ a. (lit.) mounted on a swing; (fig.) uncertain, irresolute, disquieted. 
-चलचित्तवृत्ति a. One whose mind is agitated like a swing. 
-यन्त्रम् drugs tied up in a cloth and boiled out over a fire; [[Bhāva P.]] 
-युद्धम् uncertainty of success, a fight with varying success; दोलायुद्धं कृतगुरुतरध्वानमौद्धत्यभाजाम् [[Śi. 18. 80.]] 
-लोल a. uncertain.

Den. Ā. 
__1 To swing, rock to and fro, oscillate, fluctuate, vacillate (fig. also). 
__2 To be restless or uneasy.

a. 
__1 Swinging, oscillating. 
__2 Wavering, vacillating. 
__3 Perplexed, doubtful.
